topic: reproducibility equivalents research: what techniques from reproducible-builds prior art (like reproducible-mkosi) map onto an OS image project, and which equivalents are worth adopting

subtopics.scope: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH semantics for reproducible OS image builds: the spec, tool support, commit-derived vs fixed-zero epoch values, and enforcement against drift.
seed_queries: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH mkosi deterministic image build timestamp

subtopics.scope: Pinning the build toolchain: Nix flake pins vs fork plus git-SHA pins vs version floors like mkosi MinimumVersion, and how each constrains build inputs.
seed_queries: mkosi pin version reproducible build toolchain nix flake
pin toolchain git commit reproducible builds fork

subtopics.scope: Two-build reproducibility verification: building twice and diffing (diffimage.sh style, buildx builders, sha256, systemd-dissect mtree) across image, installer, and firmware artifacts.
seed_queries: reproducible-mkosi diffimage build twice sha256 diff
verify reproducible OS image build twice compare systemd-dissect mtree

subtopics.scope: Deterministic seeds and identifiers in image builds: mkosi Seed=, repart seeds, UUID derivation per commit and architecture, and collision avoidance.
seed_queries: mkosi Seed UUID reproducible image build repart seed
deterministic UUID derivation reproducible partition image build

subtopics.scope: Build-state nondeterminism: machine-id, random-seed, ldconfig aux-cache, package manager caches, PYTHONHASHSEED, and other mutable build residue.
seed_queries: reproducible build machine-id random-seed container image nondeterminism
PYTHONHASHSEED reproducible build package cache ldconfig aux-cache

subtopics.scope: Inheriting upstream reproducibility fixes through version floors: mkosi PRs 1834, 1837, 1982, 2163, related systemd fixes, and MinimumVersion enforcement.
seed_queries: mkosi reproducibility fixes pull request SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH cpio sort
systemd mkosi reproducible build upstream improvements PR

subtopics.scope: Attesting reproducible outputs: cosign attestation, in-toto, SLSA provenance, Rekor transparency for OCI images as the open adoption opportunity.
seed_queries: cosign in-toto attestation OCI image provenance
SLSA provenance attestation container image GitHub Actions

subtopics.scope: Fetch independence and package caching or vendoring: mirror state as a reproducibility input, mkosi.cache vendoring, and reproducible-builds.org foundations.
seed_queries: reproducible builds package mirror independence vendoring
mkosi cache packages reproducible image build offline

subtopics.scope: Peer projects and prior art: flashbots mkosi-poc, arch-mkosi-boxes, upstream mkosi --reproduce PR 1115, and reproducible-builds.org.
seed_queries: flashbots mkosi-poc reproducible TDX image build
mkosi --reproduce flag pull request reproducible builds
